edits.field_name: Severance savings and interest paid to the employee
edits.current: THE FIRST OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance savings and the interest on them ACTUALLY PAID to the employee in the period - typically the January interest payment and any authorised partial withdrawal or termination settlement. Excluded from the monthly withholding base under ET art. 206 num. 4 but still certified here. SOURCE: wage types 62110 Cash-out of Severance Pay - Social Benefits -541S and 62117 Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay - Social Benefits-541R (termination and settlement payments), 62126 Advance Severance Last Year (authorised partial payments) and 62127 Advance Interest Severance Pay (the annual interest on severance, paid in January). Provision wage types (22110, 22112, 42110, 42112) and balance wage types (63814, 63815, 64999, 68028) are accruals or balances, not payments, and are not certified here.
edits.proposed: THE FIRST OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance savings and the interest on them ACTUALLY PAID to the employee in the period - typically the January interest payment and any authorised partial withdrawal or termination settlement. Excluded from the monthly withholding base under ET art. 206 num. 4 but still certified here. SOURCE: wage types 62110 Cash-out of Severance Pay - Social Benefits -541S and 62117 Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay - Social Benefits-541R (termination and settlement payments), 62126 Advance Severance Last Year (authorised partial payments) and 62127 Advance Interest Severance Pay (the annual interest on severance, paid in January). Provision wage types (22110, 22112, 42110, 42112) and balance wage types (63814, 63815, 64999, 68028) are accruals or balances, not payments, and are not certified here. An integral-salary employee (WT 62140 Integral Salary) accrues no cesantias and no interest on them (CST art. 132 num. 2): nothing is certified here for such an employee, including on termination; the integral salary itself is certified in full in casilla 36. Interest accompanies every direct payment of cesantias: WT 62117 is paid in the same month as WT 62110 (termination or partial settlement, Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1), not only in January.
edits.reason: Append only. Both round-3 settlements are integral-salary leavers with cesantias days computed (240 / 255) but base 0 and no 62110 / 62117 line (Liquidacion!E24/J24, F16/J16); the cell does not state the integral-salary case. The file-1 'Acumulados' sheet (2024 accumulation of another, ordinary-salary employee) shows 62117 in the same months as 62110 (April / July / October 2024) and 62127 in January 2025, so the interest wage type is not a January-only payment.
